name: Pi 5 22-to-15 FPC, 200 mm
class: Raspberry Pi camera cable "Standard-Mini" 22-to-15 pin, 200 mm (official)
routing_note: up from CAM/DISP 1 beside the HDMI plug, forward over the cooler at z 30-39, S-fold of 9 layers over the fin end (bend r >= 1), down the camera rear face to its 15-pin connector

name: micro-HDMI to micro-HDMI 200 mm, 90 deg up plug at the Pi
class: micro-HDMI D-D, 200 mm (+10/-0), shielded thin coax OD 3.0; Pi end 90 deg up plug (<= 8.5 mm off the board, Q2), board end right-angle with the cable leaving -Y (EVF-SELECTION A3)
keepouts: ko_hdmi_pi ko_hdmi_link ko_hdmi_run ko_panel_link ko_hdmi_coil ko_hdmi_evf
routing_note: up from HDMI0, back along the panel side under the dials (z 39.6-44), slack coil over the stick guide (ko_hdmi_coil, x -139..-113.5), down to the board lower edge through the slot gap y 4-17; r7 (BX-1): the board end is plugged in the body after the pair is home, upward (+Z) through the bottom-rail gap from the open left side

name: USB-A to 2-pin 5 V lead, 1N5817 in the + conductor, JST PH 2-pin junction at the board end
class: USB-A male to 2-wire lead (24-26 AWG, 200 mm class) + 1N5817 in the + conductor + JST PH 2-pin wire-to-wire junction at the board end
routing_note: from the upper USB 2 port up the right-rear corner (y < -24) to z 64-70, across to the board 5 V pigtail; diode and splice under adhesive heat-shrink; r7 (BX-9): PH junction mated outside (pair held about 60 mm out), rides in above the bottom rail beside the board, pushed into ko_5v_end once the board is home

name: OLED flex 50 mm (kit)
class: Hicenda kit flex FM04112-MF1-A, 50 mm (with the panel)
routing_note: from the OLED cell (open +Y) straight back to the board ZIF; mated outside the body (foam pad stuck to the OLED back first, r7 BX-7), then the OLED and the board go in together as a tethered pair (step 6); no fold beyond the kit form

name: QT lead 250 mm: Adafruit 4397 (sockets) spliced to Pololu 5521 (JST-SH)
class: QT lead 250 mm (240-270): Adafruit 4397 STEMMA QT female sockets (D2-24) spliced to Pololu 5521 JST-SH 4-pin (D2-24B), splice W-QT; or a one-piece 240-270 mm lead of the same ends (MP-QT buy-check)
keepouts: ko_qt_lead ko_lead_wall ko_lead_link ko_lead_cross ko_qt_tail ko_qt_plug
routing_note: header end plugged at step 4 on pins 1/3/5/6 (ko_qt_lead; single 1-pin housings, seated with tweezer tips), up the right wall (ko_lead_wall, z 36.6-44), across behind the blower inlet (ko_lead_cross, x -84..-74; splice in its straight run, y -29..17, joints 91-115 mm from the socket tip), up the tail (ko_qt_tail) to the plug at the encoder -X socket (ko_qt_plug); r7 (BX-2): the JST-SH end is plugged at step 8 with the panel held 60 mm off (mating pose qt_enc); the spare folds into ko_lead_stow at +30 mm

name: run button lead (pre-wired, Dupont)
class: pre-wired momentary button lead with female sockets (Squid Button class)
keepouts: ko_run_drop ko_run_floor ko_run_rise ko_run_link ko_run_cross ko_lead_wall ko_run_leads
routing_note: up from the grip cradle through the base opening and the floor run-lead hole, along the floor channel under the X1203, up the port-side rise (ko_run_rise), over the cooler shroud under the camera (ko_run_cross, x -27..-21, z 36.6-39.8), along the right wall (ko_lead_wall) down to pins 37/39 (plugged at step 4)

name: 2-way Dupont-to-JST PH lead 200 mm + 50 mm PH pigtail on the switch (2 joints)
class: 2-way Dupont F to JST PH 2-pin lead, 200 mm (header side) + 50 mm JST PH pigtail soldered to the switch lugs (2 joints); the PH pair is the step-8 inline junction
keepouts: ko_run_leads ko_lead_wall ko_lead_link ko_lead_cross ko_hdmi_run ko_panel_link ko_fps_up
routing_note: header end plugged at step 4 on pins 33/34, up the right wall (ko_lead_wall), across behind the blower inlet (ko_lead_cross), back along the panel-side channel (ko_hdmi_run), up to the switch lugs (ko_fps_up); PH junction mated first at step 8, both hands, with the panel propped 60 mm off (mating pose fps_ph); r7 (BX-2): the spare and the PH junction fold into ko_lead_stow at +30 mm

name: XT30 pigtail 18 AWG, cut length 200 mm + d_board (PIGTAIL, G-W2)
class: 18 AWG silicone pair, cut to L_cut = 200 mm + d_board (set at G-W2; 200-225 mm: d_board over 25 mm stops step 1, G-W5 drop, `lead_access` pigtail_drop), XT30U female; soldered to the X1203 battery pads (2 joints), RTV strain relief at the pads (neutral cure, not acetoxy; no standoff tie); r4: inline 15 A fuse (Littelfuse 0251015.MXL) in the + conductor within about 25 mm of the XT30 female (2 joints, inside L_cut)
keepouts: ko_pig_wrap ko_pig_under ko_pig_in ko_pig_drop ko_pig_link ko_xt30
routing_note: from the X1203 pads on the top face, straight in from inside the board (y < 23), to the W mark on the port edge (x -37.5, 31.5 mm from the button-end edge; pad position Q2); round the edge in a U over Kapton (ko_pig_wrap), the leg taped flat under the board (ko_pig_under, ko_pig_in), down the pigtail hole into the grip to the junction; 136-141 mm stored folded above the pack with the pack lead (ko_xt30); the sleeved fuse (about 20 x dia 5) lies along X beside the XT30 pair, both flat on the pack top under the run button (r7 fix-up); L_cut = 200 + d_board, rounded up to 5 mm

name: pack lead 18 AWG
class: 18 AWG silicone pair, 60 mm, XT30U male (part of the pack)
routing_note: from the pack BMS to the junction above the pack at the grip mouth
